topic: Kaplanyan screen-space curvature geometric specular AA vs sub-pixel bevel sparkle strobe rig
topic_zh: Kaplanyan 屏幕空间法线曲率几何高光抗锯齿对比亚像素倒角高光爆闪
scope: Deterministic Anton Kaplanyan & Alexey Antonov (HPG 2016) screen-space normal-variance geometric specular anti-aliasing (alpha_AA = sqrt(alpha_0^2 + kappa^2)) versus naive unfiltered raw roughness and 64-tap sub-pixel normal convolution quadrature across 17 sub-pixel drift stations (delta in [-0.40, +0.40] px). No neural super-resolution execution.

protocol.function: α_AA = √(min(1, α₀² + min(σ_max², ∥∂n/∂x∥² + ∥∂n/∂y∥²))) → Strobe Ratio 1.08× (0 Fireflies)

robustness.name: Sampled 17 sub-pixel drift stations preserve calm 1.08x temporal specular envelope without firefly strobing

good_fit: Eliminating sub-pixel specular sparkle on curved CAD bevels, car bodies, and gun barrels without normal maps (UE5, Frostbite, Unity HDRP)
Explaining why Toksvig mipmap filtering alone cannot fix geometric curvature aliasing when no normal map is bound
Preventing TAA history clamping failure and HDR Bloom fireflies caused by 50.40x sub-pixel highlight strobing
Replacing 64-tap sub-pixel supersampled shading with a 4-op screen-space derivative roughness widening
not_for: Flat planar mirrors with zero geometric curvature (∂n/∂x = ∂n/∂y = 0)
Pure Lambertian matte clay surfaces with zero specular reflectance
Neural temporal super-resolution upscalers (DLSS / FSR / XeSS)
Geometric silhouette staircase aliasing (which requires MSAA / TAA rather than roughness filtering)
